objective: Recover evidence-bearing work from disposable sessions without using the user as courier
deduplication: source_ref + source_digest + work_id; preserve conflicts as branches, never silently overwrite

public_projection.rule: public projections require explicit custody authorization; no default public echo

resume.idempotency: repeat same source version yields same record key and no duplicate publication
resume.fencing: one elected writer per conflicting record revision; other workers may independently challenge
resume.failure: partial drain remains HELD with last verified checkpoint
resume.restart: load durable record, verify hashes, then resume from checkpoint

acceptance_tests: same source replay does not duplicate drain
different source version preserves both versions and supersession relation
private draft does not appear in public projection
stale writer cannot replace newer revision
crash between checkpoint and publication resumes without double publish
independent observer distinguishes source commit from receiver ACK
a public atlas rebuilds from receipts without original chat tab
